meta.title: Reviews — Cottage Aesthetics
meta.description: Genuine 5-star Google reviews for Cottage Aesthetics, nurse-led medical aesthetics in Hartlebury.

ctaStrip.title: Come and experience it for yourself

items.name: Bev D.
items.text: I visited Cottage Aesthetics for Jalupro Super Hydro Skin Boosters with Purdi and once again had a fantastic experience. Her clinic was as welcoming, beautiful and spotless as ever.”

items.name: Sophie V.
items.text: I had such a positive experience with Purdi. I accidentally arrived a day early and she still managed to fit me in — it says a lot about her care for her clients.”

items.name: Lucy C.
items.text: Skin boosters and botox at Cottage Aesthetics — couldn't be more impressed. Everything was explained so clearly, including the science, which made me feel completely informed and confident.”

items.name: Taylor J.
items.text: I recently had Botox at Cottage Aesthetics and couldn't be happier with the results! Professional, friendly and relaxing from start to finish. Purdi took her time to explain everything.”

items.name: Lucy H.
items.text: My first time having lip filler. I was quite worried but Purdi spent ages discussing what I wanted and any concerns I had. She really put me at ease.”

items.name: Jennifer S.
items.text: I felt truly listened to for the first time in my Botox journey — incredibly warm, welcoming and knowledgeable, and she tailors your treatment to you.”

items.name: Laura L.
items.text: A wonderful experience. From the moment I arrived I felt completely at ease. A truly lovely person — warm, reassuring and clearly very talented.”

items.name: Ella S.
items.text: The loveliest experience getting my first microneedling treatment. Purdi talked me through every step and made me feel really comfortable and relaxed.”

items.name: Emma C.
items.text: Purdi has done a fantastic job for me. I'd been to a couple of places before that weren't delivering results — she listened, and I'm thrilled. Would recommend her in a heartbeat!”
